paper.title_en: On the Spontaneous symmetry breaking of Conformal Gravity to Weyl and Einstein Gravities
paper.abstract_en: Does the special-conformal connection remain an auxiliary field when a spontaneously broken conformal gauge theory is promoted to a fully dynamical Yang-Mills-Higgs theory, and under what conditions does its elimination yield Weyl gravity? We address these questions within an $\mathrm{SO}(2,4)$ gauge-theoretic formulation of gravity. Revisiting the gravitational sector selected by spontaneous symmetry breaking through an adjoint $15$-plet, we retain the special-conformal connection as an independent field and demonstrate that, on a source-free projected branch, its algebraic equation of motion determines it in terms of the Schouten tensor. Eliminating this connection yields the four-dimensional Weyl-squared action, up to the Euler density, without imposing the Schouten relation as an additional geometrical constraint. We then extend the analysis to the standard local Yang-Mills-Higgs theory and show that the special-conformal connection remains auxiliary, owing to the structure of the invariant bilinear form of $\mathfrak{so}(2,4)$, which prevents the appearance of an independent kinetic operator. The additional gauge and scalar sectors can modify its algebraic solution, so the exact Weyl reduction is restricted to the source-free branch. We further investigate the linearised spectrum of the reduced Weyl theory around de Sitter spacetime, identifying massless and partially massless spin-2 branches, with the latter occurring at $m_{\mathrm{PM}}^2=2Λ/3$. Finally, we discuss the subsequent symmetry breaking induced by an antisymmetric scalar $6$-plet and its role in connecting the Weyl-gravity phase to Einstein gravity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在 SO(2,4) 规范理论框架下重新审视共形引力自发对称破缺，论证特殊共形联络在无源投影分支上为辅助场并可由 Schouten 张量确定，消去后得到 Weyl 平方作用量；随后推广到 Yang-Mills-Higgs 理论并分析 de Sitter 背景下的线性化谱与部分无质量自旋-2 分支。理论构造深入、逻辑链条清晰，对修改引力与联络/仿射结构研究有较高参考价值。
decision.title_zh: 论共形引力自发对称破缺为Weyl引力与Einstein引力
decision.abstract_zh: 当自发破缺的共形规范理论被提升为完全动力学的 Yang-Mills-Higgs 理论时，特殊共形联络是否仍然作为辅助场存在，以及在什么条件下消去它能够得到 Weyl 引力？我们在引力的 $\mathrm{SO}(2,4)$ 规范理论表述中处理这些问题。重新审视通过伴随 $15$-重态的自发对称破缺所选择的引力扇区，我们将特殊共形联络保留为独立场，并证明在无源的投影分支上，其代数运动方程用 Schouten 张量将其确定。消去该联络后得到四维 Weyl 平方作用量（至 Euler 密度项），而无需将 Schouten 关系作为额外的几何约束强加。随后我们将分析推广到标准的局域 Yang-Mills-Higgs 理论，并证明由于 $\mathfrak{so}(2,4)$ 的不变双线性形式的结构阻止出现独立的动能算符，特殊共形联络仍为辅助场。额外的规范扇区和标量扇区可以修改其代数解，因此精确的 Weyl 约化被限制在无源分支上。我们进一步研究约化后 Weyl 理论在 de Sitter 时空附近的线性化谱，识别出无质量与部分无质量的自旋-2 分支，后者出现在 $m_{\mathrm{PM}}^2=2Λ/3$ 处。最后，我们讨论由反对称标量 $6$-重态诱导的后续对称破缺及其在连接 Weyl 引力相与 Einstein 引力中的作用。
